spans.s:
cl. 1. Ā. ˚कते (pf. डुढौके [Pāṇ. vii, 4, 59, Kāś.] Hcar.; Bhaṭṭ.),
to approach (with acc.), Kād.; Hcar.; Bhaṭṭ. :
Caus. ढौकयति (aor. अडुढौकत्, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 2 and 59, Kāś.),
to bring near (to gen.), cause to come near, offer, to any one (dat.), Kathās.; Rājat.; Bhaṭṭ.; KātyŚr., Sch.:
Desid. डुढौकिषते, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 59 and viii, 4, 54, Kāś. :
Intens. डोढौक्यते, vii, 4, 82,
offering, present, Rājat. vi, 166; Śatr. xiv; KātyŚr., Sch.
